title: The Bright Echo
author: Vesper Nystrom
blurb: Marguerite Vasquez, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
